dogecoin.text:
I remember everyone laughed at me and told me #Dogecoin would never come back. 

Look at $DOGE now 

And this is only the beginning…

$BTC $Doge

Dogecoin, launched in 2013 as a joke, has become a popular cryptocurrency thanks to its fun, meme-based origin and strong community support. Known for its Shiba Inu logo, DOGE is often used for tipping online, donations, and microtransactions.
